items.name: BRANDBOOT-001
items.reason: A governed BRANDBOOT-001 LAB candidate already exists and is the intended brand-contract source. Preserve/wrap that candidate; this profile does not silently promote it or create another brand engine.

items.name: Automated brand tokens
items.reason: Deterministic PREPROD-local token generation is implemented from the governed brand contract and produces design-token/brand-CSS outputs with zero external provider binding or cost.

items.name: Claude Commerce Agents
items.reason: Reference patterns only. Commerce functionality remains provider-neutral and composed over existing CEREBRO engines; no Claude runtime dependency is introduced.

items.name: Shopping Agent capability
items.reason: A provider-neutral shopping-agent plan exists over existing sales/communication engines. Order/payment/customer mutations remain disabled.

items.name: Merchant Agent capability
items.reason: A provider-neutral merchant-agent plan composes existing sales/payment/invoice/communication engines. Charge, refund, invoice and order mutations remain off.

items.name: App Factory
items.reason: App Factory is correctly modeled as a wrapper over FACT-001 + APPBOOT-001 and emits a PREPROD scaffold plan. It does not deploy, publish or create another factory engine.

items.name: Blink
items.reason: Reference-only capability with no install/provider binding. Re-open only if an exact audited gap proves unique value over existing FACT/App Factory paths.

items.name: Web apps / PWA / mobile templates
items.reason: Current main can generate the scaffold plan but the reusable template packs themselves are not evidenced as built. This is a real zero-cost FACT-001/APPBOOT-001 extension gap, not a reason to create a new engine.

items.name: text-to-CAD
items.reason: Specialized catalog-only capability. No provider, model, install or execution is justified until a concrete business requirement and source/license/hardware audit exists.
